title: Dice ladder
description: Weapon damage dice in order, one die size per step (docs/modules/weapons.md). A size step moves a weapon's dice one rung; dice on the same rung count as the same step.

items.description: One rung. The first dice is what a size step lands on; the others share the rung.

dice_step.description: Rungs the size moves the weapon's dice.

attack.description: An add on the attack target while the weapon is used, source item:<key>, origin core:origin/equipment. Undersized is easier to use, oversized harder.

value_percent.description: The weapon's price as a percent of its base price: undersized is cheaper, oversized dearer. It multiplies with the material's valueFactor (docs/core/economy.md).
